title: Tasked quest file
description: One file under config/tasked/quests/. A questline may be split across any number of these; the loader treats them as one tree and dependencies resolve across files.

$schema.description: Ignored by Tasked. For your editor, so it can autocomplete the rest of this file.

version.description: Format version. Written into new files. Present from the first release so that a future change has something to migrate from.

text.description: Either a plain string, or a translation key with an English fallback.

fallback.description: Shown if the translation is missing. Without it a player sees the raw key.

itemRef.description: An item and a count. Not an ItemStack — resolved at the moment it is used.

item.description: Namespaced item id, e.g. minecraft:oak_log. A missing mod is an error, not a warning: the quest could never be completed.

id.description: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores. This id appears in player progress files, so changing it needs an entry in `aliases`.

aliases.description: Former ids. Add one when renaming, and nothing that referenced the old name breaks.

description.description: One string per paragraph. Separate from a single newline-containing string on purpose.

defaultPrerequisiteMode.description: What every quest in this chapter uses unless it says otherwise.

dependsOn.description: Quest ids or aliases. May refer to quests in other files. A reference that resolves to nothing is an error: the quest could never unlock.

prerequisiteMode.description: Overrides the chapter's setting for this quest.

minRequired.description: How many dependencies must be satisfied. When set, prerequisiteMode is ignored — this is how "any three of these five" is written. May not exceed the number of dependencies.

repeatable.description: Completable more than once. Not yet implemented — the flag is stored and the engine arrives in Stage 3.

anyType.description: A task or a reward. The `type` field chooses the rest of the fields — see tasked:item, tasked:checkmark and tasked:xp, which are the types implemented so far.

optional.description: Tasks only. An optional task does not have to be done for the quest to complete, unless every task is optional.

autoSubmitTicks.description: Tasks only. How often the task is re-checked, in ticks. Raise it for an expensive check.

title.description: tasked:checkmark — the label on the button.
